items.title: Listing BD (Capital Markets)
items.description: Work with the Best Orderly Network is a combination of an orderbook-based trading infrastructure and a robust liquidity layer offering spot and perpetual futures orderbooks. Unlike traditional platforms, Orderly doesn’t have a front end; instead, it operates at the core of the ecosystem, providing essential services to projects built on top of it. Our DEX white-label solution is carefully crafted to save builders time and capital while granting access to our bootstrapped liquidity. Picture having the best features of CEXs while keeping settlements on-chain and maintaining full self-custody. With Orderly, anyone can create a trading application thanks to our seamless plug-and-play experience leveraging our liquidity and composability. Looking ahead, our grand vision is to create an omnichain protocol, connecting traders from both EVM and non-EVM chains within the same orderbook. A Glimpse into Your Future at Orderly Network Orderly is building a differentiated RWA offering: tokenized equities of listed small- and mid-cap companies, available exclusively on Orderly. We are looking for a Listings Business Development Manager to source, pitch, and onboard listed companies across the US, Hong Kong, Korea, and other markets. You will also work with them to bring their communities to trade. This role is designed for professionals from traditional finance who can bring existing relationships with listed companies into the crypto space. What will you be working on? Identify and prioritize target listed companies, with a focus on small-cap names. Build relationships with company leadership, CFOs, IR teams, and their advisors (FAs, ECM bankers, IR firms, market makers). Pitch the value of listing on Orderly: a new liquidity channel, community engagement, and access to crypto-native traders. Drive the listing process end to end, from first contact to go-live, working with internal product and ops teams. Work with listed partners on post-listing community activation and trading volume. Track pipeline and conversion, and report progress against listing targets regularly. About you An established network among listed companies (management teams, CFOs, or IR heads), built through roles in ECM, corporate finance, investor relations, corporate broking, or exchange listings. A track record of bringing companies to a platform or deal, such as IPO mandates, dual listings, ADR programs, or IR client wins. Strong pitching and negotiation skills with senior decision-makers. Fluent English; native speaker preferred. Self-driven and results-oriented, comfortable building an early-stage, unproven business line. Nice to have Listing or BD experience at an exchange, depositary receipts bank, RWA, tokenized equity, or STO platform. Background in a boutique investment bank, a small-cap market maker, or a listed-company IR advisory. Network covering the US, UK, Singapore, Hong Kong, or Korea markets. Basic understanding of crypto, DEXs, and tokenized assets. Interested in Learning More? Our hiring process begins by meeting with our People Team, who help facilitate the process of placing you in your new role. You can expect to share your experience and ideas in online video interviews with our hiring team, made up of management and potential new colleagues. If you have experience in developing trading systems or financial-related products is a plus. You can prepare for this interview by mentally organizing your strategies and opinions on topics such as Web3, cryptocurrency trading platforms, and your vision of how to succeed. Share this! Don’t be afraid of friends or co-workers stealing this job! If you are amazing and smart we will find a place for you. Check out our External Referral Incentives Program as well.

items.title: Sr. Data Analyst, Compliance
items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. We're looking for a Sr. Data Analyst, Compliance to join our team remotely! The primary goal of this role is to elevate decision-making by uncovering emerging trends and root causes, and by driving insights and actions that provide full visibility into business performance and operational efficiency. Beyond technical expertise, success in this role depends on being a true business partner who combines data-driven insights with strategic thinking to deliver actionable recommendations, guide decision-making, and drive measurable impact across the organization. In this role, you'll own end-to-end data management, from building and maintaining datasets and pipelines to designing dashboards and delivering insights for the Compliance team. A core part of this role is owning the logic and rule-setting behind transaction monitoring across deposits and withdrawals. You'll also contribute to experimentation infrastructure, laying the groundwork for future ML and intelligence initiatives. THE OPPORTUNITY - Own the logic and rule-setting behind transaction monitoring across deposits and withdrawals, partnering closely with Compliance to study patterns and refine detection logic - Translate compliance requirements into production detection logic, preserving correctness across alert eligibility, thresholds, customer segmentation, date windows, and deduplication - Develop and maintain Python and SQL pipelines for transaction data preparation, feature engineering, and detection workflows - Evaluate detection rules and analytical models across coverage, alert quality, threshold sensitivity, and the impact of proposed changes - Design reproducible evaluations on historical data that account for limited labels, class imbalance, and shifts in customer behaviour over time - Own testing, deployment, scheduling, monitoring, and operational support for detection workflows, including investigating data quality issues, pipeline failures, and unexpected changes in detection results - Execute historical backfills with clear validation and traceability, and maintain reliable downstream alert delivery and integrations with compliance systems - Be at the forefront of data innovation by experimenting, testing hypotheses, and translating insights into action, while incorporating software engineering best practices into pipelines and dashboards. WHAT YOU BRING - 7+ years of experience in data analysis, data science, and data management within the fintech, crypto, financial services, or gambling industry, gained in a fast-paced, high-growth environment - Experience working with compliance, fraud, funding, finance, and customer support teams and analyzing large datasets, engineering features, and applying statistical methods to practical business problems - Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience building and supporting production data or analytical systems - Hands-on experience using dbt or similar tooling to model and organize high-fidelity data for reporting and decision-making - Experience setting up and managing data pipelines with a strong understanding of workflow orchestration, plus strong software engineering practices including version control, automated testing, code review, and CI/CD - Solid statistical foundation; ML exposure is a strong plus - Proficiency with BI and data visualization tools (e.g., Hex, Tableau, Power BI, or similar) to build executive-facing dashboards - Ability to investigate production issues independently and communicate technical findings and uncertainty to non-technical stakeholders - You believe wholeheartedly in the values outlined in Kraken's Tentaclements document - A degree in a field emphasizing analytical rigor, such as analytics, software engineering, statistics, or economics - Based in Canada, the US, or Brazil, and fluent in English NICE TO HAVES - Fraud detection, AML, anomaly detection, or other risk applications - Experience with Athena, Trino, Kafka, and Kubernetes alongside the core Airflow/dbt/S3 stack - Transaction pattern analysis, customer segmentation, and detection threshold tuning - Developing or productionising machine learning models, including experiment tracking and performance monitoring - Working with sparse or delayed feedback from investigations to evaluate and improve detection - Explainability, auditability, and change control in regulated environments Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. OUR COMMITMENT Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto. We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision. As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. In doing so, you act in a solution-oriented and professional manner to ensure customer satisfaction even in difficult cases and a high-frequency environment. Root Cause Analysis & Optimization: You systematically analyze the reasons for complaints in order to identify operational weaknesses and initiate sustainable process improvements. Solution Orientation: You make well-founded decisions regarding goodwill arrangements within defined guidelines to achieve a fast and satisfactory solution for our customers. Quality Communication: You craft clear, empathetic, and comprehensive responses to complaints and ensure that every response is also regulatory compliant. Risk Assessment: You identify potential operational or legal risks at an early stage and support their minimization. items.title: Machine Learning Engineer
items.location_text: Zagreb, Croatia, HR; L'viv, Ukraine, UA
items.description: About us: EveryMatrix is a leading B2B SaaS provider delivering iGaming software, content and services. We provide casino, sports betting, platform and payments, and affiliate management to 200 customers worldwide . But that's not all! We're not just about numbers, we're about people . With a team of over 1500 passionate individuals spread across twelve countries in Europe, Asia, and the US, we're all united by our love for innovation and teamwork. Join us on this exciting journey as we continue to redefine the iGaming landscape, one groundbreaking solution at a time. Zagreb office is part of OddsMatrix, which empowers clients to unleash bold ideas and deliver outstanding player experiences. For over a decade, we have offered tailored B2B sports betting solutions for every market. Featured services include turnkey betting software (online, retail and omnichannel), real-time sports data APIs and data feeds. We are looking for a passionate and dedicated Machine Learning Engineer to join our team in Zagreb, Croatia! What you'll get to do: Analyze business requests and design, develop and optimize data-driven machine learning models. Collect, clean and prepare data for model training and evaluation. Evaluate and compare various mathematical and statistical modeling techniques, measuring performance and identifying improvement opportunities. Implement approved ML models in collaboration with developers and ensure smooth integration into production environments. Support product teams with mathematical expertise (e.g., creating formulas for new betting features or optimizing existing algorithms). Provide guidance to internal stakeholders on model usage, interpretation and potential limitations. Monitor model performance and continuously improve accuracy, scalability and reliability. Act as a strong analytical partner within a cross-functional team, contributing to product innovation and decision-making. What you need to shine: Strong background in mathematics, statistics or machine learning. Experience building, evaluating and deploying ML models in production environments, specifically deep learning architectures. Knowledge of and good awareness on when to use different Neural Network architectures, up to and including the current state of the art. Proficiency in Python (or similar language) and experience with ML libraries/frameworks. Experience with data preprocessing, feature engineering and model evaluation techniques. Understanding of performance metrics and model validation strategies. Ability to translate business problems into mathematical and technical solutions. items.title: Head of Enterprise Risk Management
items.description: About the Team The OpenAI Risk & Audit team is building an enterprise risk capability for a company operating at the frontier of AI. We help leaders identify, understand, and manage the risks that matter most while enabling responsible innovation and durable growth. We are developing a modern enterprise risk management (ERM) program and the technology foundation that powers it. Our work connects risk strategy, governance, compliance, and assurance with high-quality data, automated workflows, continuous monitoring, and AI-enabled analysis. We partner across Finance, Security, Legal, Engineering, Product, People, Operations, and Internal Audit, and provide clear reporting to senior leadership and the Board. We aim to make risk ownership practical, decision-useful, and embedded in how OpenAI builds and scales. About the Role As the Head of Enterprise Risk Management, you will help build and lead an integrated ERM program and the ERM platform that supports it. You will establish common risk language, governance, and decision processes while translating them into scalable systems, data products, and workflows. You will own enterprise risk assessments, maintain a centralized risk register, develop risk appetite and key risk indicators, and help leaders evaluate significant changes such as new products, markets, partnerships, major systems, and strategic investments. This is a senior individual contributor role for a hands-on leader who will build our ERM capability from the ground up, with the potential to build and lead a team over time. You will work with technical and business teams to connect source systems, improve data quality, automate evidence and control monitoring, and use AI to surface emerging risks and accelerate analysis. You will also help create a strong risk culture, coordinate assurance across the three lines, and communicate complex issues with clarity and sound judgment. This is an opportunity to build a next-generation capability from the ground up. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: - Design and evolve OpenAI’s enterprise risk management framework, including risk taxonomy, governance standards, risk appetite, escalation thresholds, and mitigation expectations. - Lead enterprise risk assessments and maintain a centralized, decision-useful risk register that reflects strategic, financial, operational, technology, security, compliance, and emerging risks. - Establish key risk indicators, continuous-monitoring capabilities, and executive dashboards that translate complex data into clear signals, trends, and actions. - Enable risk-informed change governance for new products, markets, partnerships, acquisitions, major systems, and other high-impact initiatives. - Lead effective governance forums working cross-functionally with key partners such as Compliance, Finance, Security and others, and prepare concise reporting for senior leadership and the Board. - Define the strategy and roadmap for a modern ERM platform that will connect with systems across the enterprise including identity, finance, HR, ticketing, code, and others through reliable integrations and shared data models. - Apply automation, policy-as-code, data analytics, and AI-assisted workflows to evidence collection, control monitoring, issue management, risk analysis, and audit or regulatory responses. - Coordinate risk activities across Finance, Security, Legal, Compliance, Engineering, Operations, and Internal Audit, clarifying ownership and reducing duplication across the three lines of defense. - Build, coach, and lead a high-performing team, strengthen first-line ownership, and foster a culture of practical risk management, curiosity, accountability, and continuous improvement. You might thrive in this role if you have: - 12+ years of experience across enterprise or operational risk, compliance, internal audit, security governance, finance, or related fields, including significant experience leading ERM or GRC programs. - A track record of building or materially scaling an enterprise risk program in a fast-growing, technology-driven, or otherwise complex global organization. - Strong command of ERM and assurance practices, including risk appetite, risk assessments, KRIs, controls, issue management, and the three-lines model; familiarity with frameworks such as COSO or ISO/IEC 27001/27017/27018/27701/42001. - Experience advising executives and presenting risk information to senior governance bodies, with the judgment to make complex tradeoffs clear and actionable. - Technical fluency with GRC platforms, data architecture, APIs, system integrations, cloud environments, and automated workflows; experience with infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, or policy-as-code is a plus. - Experience using data analytics, automation, or AI-enabled tools to improve risk sensing, evidence analysis, control monitoring, and reporting. - The ability to connect strategic, financial, operational, technology, security, and compliance risks and to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams. - Demonstrated success hiring, coaching, and developing multidisciplinary teams while operating effectively in ambiguity and at high velocity. - A relevant bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience; credentials such as CIA, CPA, CISA, CRMA, CRM, or an advanced business, legal, or technical degree are valued. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. items.title: Product Designer, Growth
items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. Our product teams work across research, engineering, product, data, and design to bring OpenAI’s technology to people and businesses around the world. Design plays a critical role in making powerful AI intuitive, useful, and trustworthy. We hold a high bar for quality and build experiences that earn users’ confidence, while moving quickly and learning from real-world feedback. We favor early validation and continuous refinement over waiting until every detail is perfect. About the Role We’re looking for a Product Designer to shape how startups, small businesses, and growing teams discover, adopt, and unlock lasting value from ChatGPT. You’ll own growth experiences across the customer journey, turning the potential of AI into meaningful, everyday impact for people across the world. This is a highly hands-on role for a designer who pairs exceptional craft with strong product judgment and an experimental mindset. You’ll tackle some of our most interesting growth challenges, using creativity, product intuition, and experimentation to discover new opportunities. We’re looking for someone who loves treating metrics as puzzles to solve, finding unexpected solutions, and learning quickly through iteration. items.title: Software Engineer, Native Mobile
items.description: About Glean: Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. About the Role: Glean is seeking a Senior Software Engineer, Mobile, to accelerate our development of fully native apps for iOS and Android. Today our apps wrap the web app; you will replace them with native Swift/SwiftUI and Kotlin/Jetpack Compose apps, harnessing AI to deliver a new refined and polished mobile experience. You will be responsible for setting strong technical foundations for these new codebases. You will: Build the apps Build and ship native iOS and Android apps in Swift/SwiftUI and Kotlin/Jetpack Compose. Ship user-facing features end to end: search, AI assistant, agents, notifications, and OS integrations such as widgets, App Intents, share extensions, live voice modes and more. Build experiences that feel native on each platform, following Apple's Human Interface Guidelines and Google’s Material Design, with strong accessibility, performance, and offline behavior. Define the mobile architecture: module boundaries, networking, persistence, concurrency, observability, and performance budgets. Build the infrastructure Own mobile CI/CD: automated builds and tests, code signing, TestFlight and Play Store deployment, phased rollouts, and release health monitoring. Set up an AI-native development workflow: an agent-friendly repo, automated test generation, AI-assisted review, and tooling that lets coding agents build, run, and verify mobile changes. Own enterprise readiness Build, sign, and ship enterprise app variants with their own configuration and distribution requirements. Own mobile authentication end to end: OAuth 2.0/PKCE, OIDC/SAML SSO, secure token and session handling, and identity-provider policies such as conditional access and device trust. Make the apps work in managed and BYOD environments: MDM, MAM, managed app configuration, app protection policies, and Android Enterprise work profiles. Design admin-controlled data protection (downloads, sharing, copy/paste, screenshots) with Security and Admin teams, and emit reliable audit events for customer security tooling. Represent mobile in enterprise security reviews and validate behavior on real managed and unmanaged devices. About you: 6+ years of software engineering experience, with 4+ years shipping production mobile apps on both iOS and Android. Proficiency in Swift or Kotlin with working knowledge of the other, and willingness to develop cross-platform fluency, as you will be responsible for both iOS and Android. You have owned mobile CI/CD pipelines and release infrastructure (e.g. Fastlane, Xcode Cloud, GitHub Actions, Gradle, code signing, staged rollouts). You use AI coding tools daily to ship faster without lowering the quality bar, and have opinions on structuring a codebase and toolchain so agents work in it effectively. Experience with mobile auth: OAuth 2.0/PKCE, OIDC/SAML, MSAL, ASWebAuthenticationSession / Custom Tabs, Keychain and Android Keystore. Experience shipping OS integrations (widgets, App Intents / Shortcuts, extensions, background work) on at least one platform. Startup mindset: comfortable owning problems end to end, from infra to pixels, in an ambiguous environment. Nice to have: migrating a hybrid or cross-platform app to native; shipping in MDM/MAM-managed enterprise environments. Location: This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our Mountain View or San Francisco office) Compensation & Benefits: The standard base salary range for this position is $140,000 - $265,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused. We’re committed to building and sustaining a diverse, inclusive workplace. We strive to attract and retain people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate on the basis of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. #LI-HYBRID AI-First Mindset at Glean: At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required. items.description: WE ARE BETCLIC 🎯 Betclic, European leader in sports betting, is much more than just an online gaming site! Also offering Poker, Horse Racing, and Casino games across various countries and continents, it is an inspiring and forward-thinking company: every day brings new challenges in a modern and dynamic environment. As an influential player in the tech industry, with strong and sustained growth over the years, we believe in innovation through diversity and inclusion and encourage everyone to reach their full potential. With our multicultural team, we provide an optimal, safe and responsible gaming experience, powered by cutting-edge technology. WHY JOIN US? 🚀 At Betclic, success comes from passionate and committed teams. Here’s why you’ll love working with us: 💡An international and creative environment where every project is an opportunity to innovate 📈Hypergrowth that brings new challenges and development opportunities every day 🏡A healthy work-life balance: flexible remote work and workplace well-being are essential pillars for us. 🌟A unique and friendly atmosphere, with 1,600 employees across 5 countries and our headquarters in Bordeaux Are you passionate about sports and tech? Join us and help shape the future of online gaming! ENTER THE GAME 🎮 As a Security Engineer, you will join Betclic’s Global Security team as a member of the Cybersecurity Referents team. You will work directly within squads responsible for authentication, identity and payment journeys. You will act as an embedded security partner throughout the product lifecycle, from initial design and architecture discussions through implementation, security validation and continuous improvement. This is a hands-on role combining application security and architecture analysis. When relevant, you will also perform pragmatic offensive security testing. You will help teams identify relevant risks, implement effective security controls and deliver secure, reliable and user-friendly experiences. YOUR ROLE WITHIN BETCLIC 🔥 Your role will be to strengthen security across several business and technology domains at Betclic, with a focus on Data and Sports Betting. Working closely with Developers, Architects, Product Managers and Engineering Managers, you will: Conduct secure design reviews and threat modeling for new projects, providing pragmatic and actionable recommendations. Assess existing implementations—including source code, APIs, data flows and security controls—to identify vulnerabilities and opportunities for improvement. Identify realistic attack paths affecting critical business journeys and validate them through controlled security testing or proof-of-concept exercises when useful. Work with teams to implement security improvements, promote secure development practices and share reusable security patterns. Propose, lead and contribute to security initiatives that reduce risks across the Data domain and your assigned business domain. Collaborate with the wider Security organization, including the Blue and Red Teams, as well as Compliance and Fraud teams. Why join this role? Strengthen security across Betclic’s Data activities and a strategic business domain. Work directly with teams and influence security from architecture through implementation. Bring your software development experience to practical application security challenges. Help teams implement meaningful security improvements, rather than stopping at recommendations. Develop broad expertise across application security, data security, secure software engineering and business domains. Work collaboratively with the wider Security organization in an international environment. TECHNOLOGY & SECURITY LANDSCAPE 💻 Application security: Threat modeling, secure design reviews, source code and API reviews, and controlled security testing. Data security: Data flows, access rights, data exposure risks, and security controls for data processing and sharing. Technologies: You will encounter C#, Rust, Kotlin, Dart and Flutter. Experience with one or more of these technologies is an advantage. Secure delivery: CI/CD security controls, SAST, DAST, SCA, IaC scanning and secrets management. Business context: Experience working with data platforms , online betting or gaming products systems is a plus. WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR? 🔍 We are looking for passionate and curious professionals who bring kindness and a touch of enthusiasm! This job is for you if you: Have 3–5 years of experience in cybersecurity, with a focus on securing applications or digital products. Have experience working directly with Product and Engineering teams in an agile environment. Have a solid understanding of software development practices and the challenges developers face. Are comfortable analyzing both security architecture and implementation details. Understand the security principles behind modern authentication and identity systems. Are proactive and able to identify, propose and drive security improvements. Can communicate effectively with developers, architects, product managers and business stakeholders. Have experience with web and API security. Cloud experience with AWS or Azure is a plus, but not required. Are fluent in English. WHAT ARE THE RECRUITMENT STEPS? 📝 If your application is shortlisted, Sebastien or Maxime will contact you within a week for an initial HR screening (30 minutes). Then, you will complete the AssessFirst test (personality, motivation and cognitive reasoning). Next, you will meet Philippe, Senior Security Referent Manager. About two weeks later, you will take a technical test with one of our Security experts. Finally, Sebastien or Maxime will conduct a final HR interview to review your AssessFirst results together. The recruitment process usually takes between 4 to 6 weeks to ensure an optimal experience for you. WHAT CAN YOU EXPECT? 🎁 ✅ 25 days of paid leave and 10 RTT days 🍽️ A Ticket Restaurant® card credited with €11 per day (€6 per day funded by Betclic) 🩺 100% health insurance coverage for you and your children 🚆 50% reimbursement of public transport costs or an annual sustainable mobility allowance (€230 for commuting with sustainable transport) 🏡 Hybrid work model 📚 Access to a vast training catalog, with opportunities for professional development every year 🏢 Extraordinary office spaces with a rooftop where you can enjoy sunny breaks with a view of the Cité du Vin 🎉 Internal events to liven up your daily life 🏋️ On-site sports classes and organized tournaments (Pilates, circuit training, boxing, yoga, futsal, padel, tennis…) Permanent contract, available immediately in Bordeaux (remote from another city possible depending on profile - on-site presence required twice a month). items.title: Data Center Hardware Engineer
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE MISSION You will work every day on the racks that power one of France's largest AI clusters. Mistral's compute footprint is our single largest investment and the foundation of our AI research and engineering. We're hiring Data Center Hardware Engineers to keep our GPU/CPU clusters healthy, safe and growing — hands-on, in the data center, at the intersection of high-performance computing and physical infrastructure. You'll join a small, senior team working at a scale few engineers get to experience: GPU-dense racks (H100/H200-class and next-generation platforms), high-speed interconnects, liquid-cooled systems — with new sites under development in France and beyond. Hardware here is not someone else's problem. As part of a small on-site team, you carry responsibility for it end to end. Location: On-site at one of our data center in Bessé-sur-Braye, Pays de la Loire. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Diagnose & repair server and cluster hardware: CPUs, memory, drives, NICs, GPUs, PSUs, and interconnect problems (switches, cables, transceivers; Ethernet/InfiniBand). - Intervene safely — power-off/lockout, ESD discipline, pre/post-work checklists, tidy and safe work areas. - Capture everything — photos, serials, test results; open, update and close tickets with notes the next engineer can act on. - Manage parts — receive, label and track inventory; run RMAs and coordinate with vendors. - Help us get better — feed recurring anomalies into monitoring, alerts and SOPs; contribute small scripts (Python/Bash) if you have those skills. - Be a good teammate — clear status updates, honest handovers, and respect for the people depending on the cluster. ABOUT YOU - Hands-on comfort in data centers or server hardware — you can (or will quickly learn to) work cleanly in racks: rails, cabling, labeling, mounting. - Disciplined and meticulous: checklists aren't bureaucracy to you, they're craftsmanship. - Practical electrical basics: power-off procedures, PPE, short-circuit risk awareness. - Basic Linux (boot checks, logs) — scripting is a plus, not a requirement. - Physically able to work in racks (lift, mount, maneuver) in a data center environment. - Comfortable in a 24/7 operation, including a rotating on-call with emergency response expectations. - Driver's licence (B) for travel between our sites. EVEN IF YOU DON'T MATCH EVERY CRITERION Many of our best hardware engineers came from research labs, telecoms, IT services or the military. If you are rigorous, curious and genuinely motivated by hardware at scale, we would be glad to hear from you — we assess demonstrated scope rather than keyword matching. NICE TO HAVE - HPC/AI/cloud production experience at scale; large-fleet server install and maintenance. - Networking fundamentals (Ethernet/InfiniBand) beyond basics. - Vendor/RMA tooling, ticketing (Jira/ServiceNow), inventory systems. - Python/Bash automation for checks, capture, inventory or reporting. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.title: Principal Software Engineer, Productivity
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The Connector Ecosystem team builds the platform and product experiences that let people extend ChatGPT and Codex. We work on plugins, skills, connectors, interactive apps, and open standards like the Model Context Protocol (MCP). We make plugins easy to discover, install, and use, ensure they’re invoked at the right time, and help people find new ways to get value from them. We want anyone to be able to turn a useful workflow into a plugin, share it, and have other people use it. A plugin can package instructions and skills with connections to the tools and data it needs. Our work spans creation and publishing, reliable execution across our products, clear permissions and approvals, and the controls admins need to bring plugins to their organizations. We work closely with research to improve tool quality as models evolve. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a product-minded Principal Software Engineer to set technical direction, build the systems behind plugins, and improve how models use them. Depending on your focus, you may scale generalist infrastructure and identity-related integrations across products, improve plugin quality at the intersection of backend engineering and applied AI, or work on the product experience itself to drive plugin usage. You’ll lead complex initiatives across teams and own problems from diagnosis and design through implementation and release. You’ll remain hands-on while driving product and design decisions alongside Product, Design, Research, and engineering partners. You’ll help shape what we build and how it works, translate user and developer needs into clear priorities, and guide technical decisions that balance rapid iteration with long-term reliability and maintainability. This role is based in San Francisco. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL - Set technical direction and lead complex initiatives across the Plugin Ecosystem, aligning architecture and execution across teams. - Drive product and design decisions with cross-functional partners, helping define priorities and shape intuitive experiences for users and developers. - Design and ship APIs, SDKs, and services that developers use to extend ChatGPT and Codex. - Build intuitive experiences that help users discover, install, and use plugins to get more done. - Make plugins easier to create, test, publish, update, and share. - Improve when and how models use plugins, from choosing the right plugin to completing a task. Work with Research to diagnose failures and measure improvements as models evolve. - Improve plugin reliability and interaction quality across ChatGPT and Codex, including interactive apps, with clear error messages and recovery paths. - Build consistent permissions, approvals, and admin controls that help individuals and organizations confidently adopt plugins. - Work with developers and partners to turn recurring problems into improvements to the platform, tooling, and documentation. - Collaborate across engineering, Product, Research, Security, and Trust & Safety to scale plugin infrastructure and deliver safe, reliable execution. - Raise the engineering bar through mentorship, thoughtful code reviews, and clear technical guidance. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU - Have 10+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of building and shipping products or platforms that people and developers rely on. - Have led complex technical initiatives across teams and driven product and design decisions in close partnership with product managers and designers. - Care about product quality and can make complex capabilities feel intuitive, from discovering a useful plugin to completing a task with it. - Have strong opinions about APIs and abstractions, and can explain the tradeoffs behind your decisions. Experience with identity, permissions, or integration-heavy systems is especially valuable. - Enjoy talking with users and developers, understanding what they’re trying to accomplish, and turning recurring problems into product and platform improvements. - Can move between product questions and technical details, collaborate across teams, and take an ambiguous problem through to production. - Are comfortable working across web interfaces and backend systems. Experience building applied AI systems, diagnosing model–tool interactions, and measuring reliability and quality is especially valuable. - Have built products people rely on or software that other developers use, such as an API or SDK, an open-source project, a developer platform, or internal tools with real users. items.title: Partner Enablement Lead, Beneficial Deployments
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic's Beneficial Deployments team brings Claude to organizations doing some of the world's most important work across the nonprofit and education sectors. These organizations share a problem: mission-critical work, thin budgets, and little slack to figure out new technology on their own. Our Customer Success team helps them go from first login to Claude being part of how their teams work, but we cannot do that one organization at a time, nor should we. The sector already has trusted intermediaries these organizations turn to first: networks, capacity builders, funder technical assistance providers, community colleges, and fellowship programs. This role exists to make those intermediaries as effective at activating and training organizations on Claude as our own Customer Success team is. As the Scaled Enablement Lead, you'll build the Claude for Nonprofits train-the-trainer program that qualifies intermediaries to onboard organizations and deliver Anthropic-designed workshops on our behalf. You'll own the kits, credentials, and quality gates that let them run the show without an Anthropic CSM in the room. You'll also own the enablement thinking behind scaling impact through Claude Corps : how what fellows learn and build serves every organization we support, not only the ones that host them. The people you enable are not selling Claude. They are trainers, implementers, and program staff whose job is to help mission-driven organizations meaningfully adopt AI. Your job is to make sure these intermediaries can do that with Claude, to the same bar we hold ourselves to, and to help them evolve their offerings as we learn what these organizations need. The measure of success for this role is organizations activated and trained well without Anthropic delivering it. You'll be half program builder, half facilitator. You'll design and deliver the first cohorts yourself, then make the system repeatable: kits, qualification paths, credentials, teach-back gates, and a refresh rhythm that keeps content current as our products change. You'll build on the operating model and certification infrastructure of Anthropic's Education team and own everything specific to this audience, working closely with Beneficial Deployments Customer Success, Partnerships, Claude Corps program leadership, and our Education teams. This is not a partner account management or alliances role, and it carries no quota. It is not a book-of-business Customer Success role either, though you'll spend time with organizations to stay grounded in what these nonprofits truly need. The role reports to the Customer Success Lead for Beneficial Deployments, has no direct reports today, and may grow into people management as the program scales. Expect periodic travel for in-person cohorts and sessions. Key responsibilities: Own the Claude for Nonprofits train-the-trainer program end to end: its tracks, the qualification path for each, the credential, and recertification Build the kits intermediaries teach from: an activation playbook covering kickoff, admin setup, launch, and Day 30/60/90 reviews, and workshop-in-a-box modules starting with AI fluency and use case discovery, each with a deck, facilitator guide, demo scripts, sample data, and workbook Recruit and qualify a pilot cohort of anchor intermediaries, then open a repeatable application process that routes each to the right track and the right home, whether the Claude Partner Network or a Beneficial Deployments credential Design and deliver enablement for network intermediaries, adapting the program to how each reaches and supports its members, and help them evolve their offerings as we learn what organizations need Build the connective tissue among intermediaries so they learn from each other: shared office hours, a facilitator cohort that stays together after qualification, and a clear path for bringing new intermediaries along Support the enablement thinking for Claude Corps: how we extend the reach of fellows and the organizations around the program, and how what they learn feeds back into the enablement every customer receives Hold the quality bar when Anthropic is not in the room through teach-back gates, graded mock sessions, shadowing, and session satisfaction and activation quality at or above Anthropic-led benchmarks Run the program as one system: content intake and refresh calendar, production standards, resource hub organization, learning management system courses and assessments, and the agreement and attribution model for intermediaries acting on Anthropic's behalf Own the program's numbers, including approved trainers, collaborator-led activations and workshops, the Anthropic effort required per organization activated, and quality against benchmark, and use them to decide where the effort goes next Be the field voice for intermediaries inside Anthropic, bringing what they learn back into our enablement content, product feedback, and engagement model Minimum qualifications: 7+ years of experience in enablement, training, or program management Train-the-trainer at scale. You have built and run a program that qualified other people to deliver your training consistently without you in the room: a certified facilitator network, a partner or community education program, or an instructor credential. Learning design and delivery. You have designed adult learning experiences end to end, including curriculum, facilitator guides, and assessments, and delivered them live Nonprofit ecosystem fluency. You have worked with or inside the intermediaries that reach mission-driven organizations (networks, capacity builders, funders, technical assistance providers) and understand how they influence adoption Hands-on proficiency with AI tools. You use Claude and/or other AI tools in your day to day and understand their impact firsthand Preferred qualifications: Comfort being the single owner of a program while depending on teams you do not manage Ownership of, or close partnership with, a certification or badging program, including assessment design and recertification Experience with Skilljar or another learning management system, and with partner portals or resource hubs Facilitation of change management or AI fluency programs for non-technical teams Time at a capacity-building organization, an intermediary, or an edtech or technology company serving the sector Experience leading work through contractors or vendors while keeping several programs coherent The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $265,000 — $320,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Head of Retention
items.description: ABOUT POLYMARKET Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future. We're growing fast, both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire. ABOUT THE ROLE Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market, and retention is one of the most important unsolved problems in the business. Traders come in for elections, crypto moves, and playoff runs, then go quiet. The gap between a one-time depositor and an active, long-term trader is where this role lives. You will build and lead the team that closes it. The retention org today is early. You will design the structure, make the hiring calls, and build the operating model from the ground up, including lifecycle, CRM operations, retention analytics, and incentives. You will manage through managers, own the incentive P&L with Finance, and be the voice of the retained trader in executive forums. This is not a role for someone who wants to inherit a playbook. The playbook does not exist yet. This hire matters because retention is now a company-level priority, not a marketing function. Active-trader retention and LTV are going into the company scorecard. The person in this role will sit in leadership reviews, shape product roadmaps, and make the call on where incentive dollars go. If you have built a retention org at a high-churn consumer business, know how to run incrementality tests, and want to work on a product that is genuinely hard to retain users on, this is the job. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Build the retention organization from an early-stage team into a full function, including lifecycle, CRM operations, analytics, and incentives, and make the calls on when to hire, what to build in-house, and what to bring in from partners. - Own active-trader retention at 30, 90, and 180 days and LTV growth as company-level KPIs, and report cohort performance, churn signals, and incentive ROI directly to the CEO and exec team. - Set and defend the retention incentive budget with Finance, using incrementality data to make the hard calls on when spend is and is not worth it. - Align Markets, Growth, Product, and Brand around a single coordinated plan for major event moments, including elections, playoffs, and crypto events, so acquisition and retention move together. - Negotiate roadmap commitments from Engineering and Data for the triggers, tooling, and data infrastructure the retention team needs to operate, including Braze, Customer.io http://Customer.io, and Amplitude. - Own messaging rules across the company, including frequency caps and channel priority, to resolve competing demands for user attention and protect the trader experience. - Work with Legal and Compliance as a peer to set retention guardrails covering CFTC rules, state eligibility, and contact permissions, so the team can move fast inside clear limits. items.title: Researcher, Misalignment Monitoring Lead
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM OpenAI's Safety Research organization works to ensure that our most capable AI models can be deployed safely and responsibly. As frontier models become increasingly capable and autonomous, developing reliable ways to monitor their behavior, identify emerging risks, and evaluate the effectiveness of safety systems becomes increasingly important. Our work focuses on advancing the research and evaluation methods needed to understand model behavior and ensure that monitoring systems remain effective as model capabilities evolve. We combine rigorous empirical research with practical safety interventions, working closely with research, engineering, and deployment teams to translate findings into improvements across OpenAI's models and products. ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a senior researcher to lead technical work on misalignment monitoring for frontier AI systems. You will develop methods to evaluate the effectiveness of AI monitors, understand their limitations, and improve our ability to detect and stop concerning model behavior reliably. This role combines research leadership with hands-on technical execution. You will set research priorities, design rigorous evaluations, investigate monitoring failures, and develop approaches for stress-testing and improving monitoring systems. A key focus will be understanding where monitors produce false positives, miss important behaviors, or become less effective as models grow more capable. You will work closely with researchers and engineers across OpenAI to turn monitoring research into practical improvements to our safety systems. We are looking for someone with strong research judgment, technical depth, and the ability to independently drive ambiguous problems from initial investigation through measurable results. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Lead the research and technical direction for evaluating and improving the misalignment monitoring of frontier AI systems. - Design and execute rigorous evaluations that measure monitor effectiveness, identify failure modes, and assess the reliability of monitoring signals. - Develop methods to stress-test and red-team monitors, including identifying behaviors that evade detection or expose weaknesses in existing approaches. - Investigate false positives, missed detections, and other monitoring failures to improve the accuracy and usefulness of safety evaluations. - Build scalable evaluation frameworks and experimental tools that enable ongoing measurement of monitoring performance as model capabilities evolve. - Translate research findings into actionable improvements, working with partner teams to strengthen monitoring systems and inform broader safety decisions. - Establish research priorities and guide technical execution, balancing foundational research questions with practical deployment needs. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU: - Have a strong background in machine learning research, particularly in model evaluations, AI safety, alignment, robustness, or related areas. - Have demonstrated the ability to lead technically challenging research projects, from identifying important questions through designing experiments and delivering results. - Bring strong experimental judgment and understand how to design evaluations that are rigorous, reproducible, and difficult to game. - Have hands-on experience building or evaluating machine learning systems, including working with large language models or other frontier AI systems. - Enjoy investigating complex failure modes and developing methods to distinguish meaningful safety signals from misleading measurements. - Are comfortable working on open-ended research problems where the right methodology or success criteria may not be obvious at the outset. - Combine strong research instincts with practical engineering ability and can independently build experiments, analyze results, and iterate quickly. - Communicate technical findings clearly and enjoy collaborating across research, engineering, and safety teams. - Are motivated by OpenAI's mission and the challenge of developing reliable oversight mechanisms for increasingly capable AI systems. NICE TO HAVE: - Experience with AI monitoring, automated evaluations, adversarial testing, or red-teaming. - Research experience in scalable oversight, AI control, model behavior analysis, or interpretability. - Experience developing monitoring or evaluation systems that are used in real-world deployments. - A track record of technical research leadership, including mentoring researchers or coordinating cross-functional research initiatives. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As a Regional Research Economist at Anthropic, you will collaborate with governments, academia, industry, and civil society in your region to measure and understand AI’s effects on the economy and explore research-driven policy interventions. You will contribute to the development of the Anthropic Economic Index and its extension to generate regionally relevant insights, establish new methodologies to measure the usage, diffusion, and impact of AI throughout the economy, and work to broaden access to and usage of the insights generated by the Index. You will use frontier methods in econometrics, machine learning, and structural estimation. Such rigor will drive impact, shaping both policy discussions externally and informing Anthropic’s internal business and product decisions. Our team combines rigorous empirical methods with novel measurement approaches. We’re building first-of-its-kind datasets tracking AI’s impact on labor markets, productivity, and economic transformation. Using our privacy-preserving measurement system ( Clio ), we analyze millions of real-world AI interactions to understand how AI augments and automates work across different occupations and tasks. For this role, we’re looking for candidates who can combine rigorous economic analysis with novel measurement approaches to understand AI’s transformative effects on the economy. The ideal candidate will be comfortable working at the intersection of empirical economics, technological change, and policy impact. Key responsibilities Build and maintain relationships with academic institutions, policy think tanks, and other research partners as the primary point of contact for these organizations on economic impact work in your region Advance research collaborations that answer country- or regional-specific economic impact questions Translate research insights into actionable recommendations for policy discussions Make fundamental contributions to the development and expansion of the Anthropic Economic Index , including country- and regional-specific analysis Design and collaborate on empirical research on AI’s economic effects with governments, academia, industry, and civil society in your region Develop new methodological approaches, in collaboration with partners in your region, for studying AI’s impact on labor markets and the future of work; productivity and task transformation; economic inequality and displacement; industry-specific disruption and adaptation; and aggregate economic trajectories (GDP, productivity, unemployment) under varying AI-adoption scenarios Work cross-functionally with other technical teams to improve our measurement infrastructure and data collection Amplify external engagement through research publications, policy briefs, and presentations to diverse stakeholders Minimum qualifications PhD in Economics Strong track record of empirical research, particularly studies combining novel data sources and economic theory or implementing frontier methods in causal inference and machine learning Demonstrated experience working in, and relevant relationships across, the region Proficiency in Python, R, SQL, or similar tools for large-scale data analysis Demonstrated ability to lead complex research projects from conception to publication Demonstrated ability to communicate technical findings to diverse audiences Demonstrated ability to build relationships across academic, policy, and industry communities Preferred qualifications Experience relevant to the study of AI’s impact on the economy, such as labor market analysis and occupational change; task-based approaches to technological transformation; large-scale data analysis and econometric methods; large language models for social science research; policy-relevant economic research; experimental and quasi-experimental methods for causal inference; macroeconomic modeling and time series forecasting; or agent-based modeling and large-scale simulation Experience working with novel datasets and measurement systems Comfort learning new technical tools and frameworks Strong interest in ensuring AI development benefits humanity Comfort working with AI systems and ability to think critically about their capabilities and limitations Representative projects How Australia Uses Claude: Findings from the Anthropic Economic Index Anthropic Economic Index Report: Economic Primitives Anthropic Economic Index Report: Uneven Geographic and Enterprise AI Adoption Estimating AI productivity gains from Claude conversations The Anthropic Economic Index Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. items.title: Director, Gift Card Program Management & Marketing
items.description: About Us Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. items.title: Software Engineer, Identity Infrastructure
items.location_text: San Francisco, New York City, Seattle
items.description: About the Team The Identity Infrastructure Engineering team builds the identity and access systems that OpenAI’s researchers, engineers, and internal teams rely on to protect critical systems and data. We partner with Research, Applied Engineering, Infrastructure, IT, and Security to make secure access practical across cloud and internal environments. About the Role We’re looking for a hands-on software engineer to design and build high-scale, high-throughput secure access proxies and the distributed systems behind them. These are tier-zero services: researchers, engineers, and agents depend on them to reach critical infrastructure safely and reliably. You’ll work at the intersection of networking, distributed systems, and infrastructure security, building the serving paths and control-plane integrations that connect identities to resources. Teleport is a core part of the current platform; the role also includes credential brokers, policy enforcement, and developer-facing integrations. You’ll own the services you build from design and implementation through production. That means understanding human, agent, and workload traffic, improving throughput and tail latency, making authorization decisions auditable, and designing for safe multi-region rollout and recovery. We’re looking for someone who can turn a demanding security requirement into software that works well at scale and is straightforward for other engineers to use. In this role, you will: - Design and implement secure access proxies, gateways, and credential brokers that provide narrowly scoped, auditable access to infrastructure and internal services while reducing standing privileges.. - Integrate identity and access policy across clients, proxies, and target systems so approved permissions take effect promptly and access expires or is revoked when required. Ensure correct behavior when policy is stale or sessions remain active. - Build observability that explains the end-to-end access path: latency, errors, saturation, authorization decisions, and identity attribution, without leaking credentials. - Engineer safe multi-region rollouts, canaries, rollback, failover, and recovery. Validate changes with realistic test environments, load tests, and failure testing. - Keep core access services reliable, performant, and maintainable. Own production support, maintenance, upgrades, and incident recovery; ship durable fixes that reduce recurring failures, alert noise, and manual work. - Make secure access easy to adopt through reusable APIs, client tooling, diagnostics, and self-service workflows. Lead migrations that preserve critical workflows, with tested rollback and recovery paths and clear ownership across Infrastructure, Security, and SRE. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have built and operated production backend, proxy, networking, or infrastructure services with demanding scale or availability requirements. - Have practical networking depth and can reason about HTTP, TCP, TLS, DNS, routing, and load balancing across real request paths. - Can explain how you handled performance bottlenecks, partial failures, multi-region deployment, or a difficult production change in a system you personally built. - Understand authentication, authorization, least privilege, trust boundaries, credential handling, and the consequences of an access-control failure. - Have strong software engineering fundamentals and experience with Go, Rust, Python, or similar languages. - Use tests, profiling, telemetry, and reproducible experiments to debug across system boundaries and verify correctness, performance, and recovery. - Make practical scope decisions, communicate tradeoffs clearly, and follow through from code to production. Teleport or comparable access-platform experience is helpful; strong engineering and production ownership matter more than knowing every tool. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.
